messages:
maya: alert — saw spike in project-level quota hits after the auth-exchange timeout change. several requests fell back to project-key and bumped project counters
ryan: which release changed timeouts?
infra-bot: auth-service v3.9.1 deployed 2026-03-22T08:13Z (grpc deadline 300ms)
maya: staging trace: `exchange -> deadline_exceeded -> fallback_route -> increment_project_quota`
zara: console UX: customers are confused; they see their SA usage missing but project usage increased
nina: can we add an "auth: fallback" badge on request rows and allow filtering in billing exports? product wants that
ryan: immediate actions: (1) rollback deadline to 500ms canary, (2) add dedupe in metering to ignore duplicate increments when same request_id shows up on fallback within 1s, (3) add origin_inferred flag in events for Console
maya: agree. I'll run query to list affected tenants (>3% delta) and loop in cs-lead before backfill
cs-lead: please ping CS with any tenants we should proactively contact
infra-bot: rollback canary started 2026-03-22T09:02Z :rocket:
zara: owners: ryan(auth), maya(metering), zara(console). I'll file the follow-ups and wire the Console filter request
maya: noted. will update thread with canary metrics and CS list.
